summary: Added the concrete consequence of the accumulated queue, which the asserted account had only stated from source. New harness case TestAssuranceReadIndexQueuedDrainBurst queues 64 same-context retries on a two-voter leader before any acknowledgement (setup: pending=64, committed=0, in_term=false), then delivers the leader's own ack plus node 2's MsgAppResp so the leader commits in its term and takes the natural MsgAppResp fast path that calls releasePendingReadIndexMessages. A local run shows that single step ends with committed=1, in_term=true, pending=0, unconfirmed=64 and 64 heartbeat broadcasts - i.e. the whole retained queue is drained at once, every entry re-admitted and one heartbeat emitted per entry. Submitted as a successor experiment for the same investigation with three comparisons (pending==0, unconfirmed==64, broadcasts==64) and the release-site sources; the interpretation is deliberately not revised until the controller produces the receipt.
